milestone: PR9 default command-WAL public raw KV cutover
features: public Set/Delete/Batch.Write raw KV writes routed to RawKVBatch typed command frames
reopen from persisted command_wal_v1 without explicit backend-only APIs
public raw KV microbenchmark coverage for point Set and batched RawKVBatch writes

performance_gate.rationale: Batched RawKVBatch command-WAL throughput is already close to cached legacy and uses fewer allocations per batch, but the default public point Set path still routes to direct backend command-WAL publication and is far slower than cached legacy. This PR is not tracker-mergeable until the cached typed command path or another point-write batching strategy closes the point Set throughput/allocation gap.

unsupported_modes: cached memtable command-WAL writes remain disabled; public command-WAL writes use direct backend command-WAL mode to avoid the legacy cached redo journal
DeleteRange and Update use existing public fallbacks and are not newly broadened beyond raw KV Set/Delete/Batch.Write support in this slice
next_required_work: implement cached typed command-WAL point writes or an equivalent public point-write batching strategy
prove point Set throughput and allocations against cached legacy with the public raw KV microbenchmark
rerun unified_bench treedb vs treedb_command_wal batch_write and point-write modes after the point-write strategy lands
